sloka: यत् हि दाशरथेः कार्यम् मम तत् न अत्र संशयः ।तत् भवन्तो मति श्रेष्ठा बलवन्तो मनस्विनः ॥४-५९-२५॥
transliteration: yat hi dāśaratheḥ kāryam mama tat na atra saṁśayaḥ ।tat bhavanto mati śreṣṭhā balavanto manasvinaḥ ॥4-59-25॥

translations.english: 'Indeed, you monkeys are very wise, strong and sensitive. The king of monkeys has sent you on this mission. You cannot be conquered even by gods.
